calculation.expression: rank_pct(-sum_60(residual_return) / std_80(residual_return)); residual_return = asset_log_return - beta_80(asset, equal_weight_market)*market_log_return
calculation.description: Ranks assets by negative 60-trading-day cumulative return unexplained by the equal-weight 15-asset market, normalized by 80-day residual volatility. Uses only observations through the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Negative in 2020-2024, positive in 2025 onward, and strongest in 2030-2033; recent efficacy is strong but regime concentration warrants monitoring.
